```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Load the dataset
coffee_survey <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2024/2024-05-14/coffee_survey.csv')

# Extract the first method 
coffee_survey$brew <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(coffee_survey$brew), ","), `[`, 1)

# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Coffee Consumption Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("selectedAge", "Select Age Range:",
                  choices = unique(coffee_survey$age)),
      hr(),
      h5("Distribution of coffee brewing methods"),
      h5("Distribution of coffee cups consumed by selected age group")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("brewingMethodsPlot"),
      plotOutput("cupsByAgePlot")
    )
  )
)



# Define server logic
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Plotly interactive bar chart for brewing methods
  output$brewingMethodsPlot <- renderPlotly({
    data <- coffee_survey %>%
      filter(!is.na(brew)) %>%
      group_by(brew) %>%
      summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      arrange(Count)
      
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = brew, y = Count, fill = brew)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      labs(title = "Coffee Brewing Methods", y = "Count") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
    
    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })
  
  
  # Reactive ggplot2 bar chart for cups of coffee by age group
  output$cupsByAgePlot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$selectedAge)
    
    data <- coffee_survey %>%
      filter(age == input$selectedAge & !is.na(cups) & cups != "NA") %>%
      group_by(cups) %>%
      summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
      
    ggplot(data, aes(x = cups, y = Count, fill = cups)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      labs(title = paste("Cups of Coffee Consumed per Day (Age Group:", input$selectedAge, ")"),
           x = "Cups per Day", y = "Frequency")
  })
}

# Run the application
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
